ns2:course.label: Senior Thesis in CS
ns2:course.description: (C S 299) Research and thesis development experience in computer science. A student works with a faculty member on a mutually agreed upon thesis topic and completes a written thesis. Work involves literature search, oral presentation, analysis and/or implementation, paper preparation, and a written thesis. 3 undergraduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing in CS and consent of instructor.
